description: She wears an opaque wine-red textured gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a full floor-length skirt. Muted gold floral and geometric woven bands edge the neck, front panels, cuffs and hem. A brown-gold bordered wrap rests around her forearms. Small decorative shoulder clasps, a central neckline brooch, a pendant necklace, drop earrings and a simple ring are visible. A narrow gold-patterned belt has a round clasp. Dark brown leather shoes show partly beneath the skirt.
